description: 1. Agent reads SKILL.md to discover the proprietary response format (5 emoji-prefixed sections: 🔗 Attachment Style, 🔍 Evidence, 💡 Your Pattern, 🎯 Strategy, 📖 Deeper). 2. Agent reads all 3 intake JSON files from intake/pending/. 3. For U-2041 (Priya): identifies Anxious attachment style, notes partner's Avoidant cues, explicitly names the Anxious+Avoidant 'pursue-withdraw death spiral' pairing dynamic, includes confidence level in the style line, provides 2-3 Anxious-specific strategies. 4. For U-2042 (Marcus): identifies Avoidant style, includes confidence level, provides avoidant-specific strategies (naming feelings, 'I need 30 minutes', staying present). 5. For U-2043 (晓薇): correctly identifies the nuanced Fearful-Avoidant (恐惧型) style — NOT simply anxious or avoidant — based on the hot-cold pattern, idealization-devaluation cycle, and push-pull behaviors; writes the ENTIRE report in Chinese due to the language rule; recommends therapy and hot-cold cycle tracking; includes childhood/trauma insight in 📖 Deeper section. All 3 reports must be saved as U-2041_report.txt, U-2042_report.txt, U-2043_report.txt in reports/final/.
